_comment: AI-Assisted: Claude Code (model: claude-opus-5) - Authored per 004 data-model.md §2.2 and contracts/authored-summary-gates.md §1-§2 (004 task T014), for curation/detachment-rules/<faction-id>.json. A bare array, keyed by summary_key on the RULE rather than by detachment_id, because a detachment may own more than one rule (284 detachment abilities over 261 detachments in the measured baseline). Filed per faction rather than per detachment so a diff names the faction and the authoring campaign -- the dominant editorial cost of this feature, roughly 336 records -- can advance faction by faction without holding a release. The rule's NAME is always carried into the bundle from the source (FR-022); only the summary is authored and gated.
title: curation/detachment-rules/<faction-id>.json

summary_key.description: detachment:<detachment-id>:<slug>. Two detachments in different factions sharing a rule name are distinct keys; a detachment renamed upstream while its rule is unchanged keeps its key AND its digest, so nothing re-reviews; a rule changed while its name is unchanged moves its digest and does re-review -- which is the whole point of digesting the mechanic rather than the name.

mechanic_digest.description: A KEYED, TRUNCATED digest (HMAC-SHA256 under a repository-held key, 128 bits) over the hard-normalised mechanic text, computed while that text exists only in ephemeral storage and then discarded (C6/R8).

digest_refreshed_at_version.description: the version id this record's mechanic_digest was re-baselined at (009 FR-028); written only when an approval is carried across a digest refresh

digest_refreshed_under_authorization.description: the named, dated Product Owner authorization record the re-baseline ran under (009 FR-029); one blanket authorization, cited by every refreshed record
